title: fscale verify --json output
description: The report printed by `fscale verify --json`. Steps are listed in the order they run: check, lint, typecheck, test.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. Changes only on a breaking change.

version.description: The firescale version that produced the report.

ok.description: True when no step failed. Skipped steps do not count as failures.

runner.description: How the lint, typecheck and test commands were chosen: all three from the config, Nx, Turborepo, package.json scripts, Cargo, or none found.

failedStep.description: Name of the first step that failed. Absent when ok is true.

rerun.description: The command to run again after fixing the failure. Absent when ok is true.

status.description: not-run means an earlier step failed, so this one was not started.

command.description: The command that ran, or would have. Absent for a skipped step.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the command. Absent when the step did not run or was killed by a signal.

detail.description: One line about the outcome: a count, the command, or why the step was skipped.

outputTail.description: The last lines of a failed step's output, without colour codes. Absent unless the step failed.
